web.title: Erasure code - Ceph Documentation
web.description:
# Erasure code [](https://docs.ceph.com/en/reef/rados/operations/erasure-code/#erasure-code)
## Erasure-code profiles [](https://docs.ceph.com/en/reef/rados/operations/erasure-code/#erasure-code-profiles)
```
k=2
m=2
plugin=jerasure
crush-failure-domain=host
technique=reed_sol_van
```

```
ceph osd erasure-code-profile set myprofile \
    k=3 \
    m=2 \
    crush-failure-domain=rack
ceph osd pool create ecpool erasure myprofile
echo ABCDEFGHI | rados --pool ecpool put NYAN -
rados --pool ecpool get NYAN -
```
